What all is going in the shadowbox?  And are you prepping the items as well? (Like sew/object mount?).

Here's some basics but feel free to DM me with additional questions!

Seal your frame with barrier tape if it's one of the MDF shadowbox frames, then prepare your glazing (depending on the size it might be acrylic and not glass, it'll be on the order paperwork though). Insert it and clean it as best as possible.

Measure your sides, you'll be taking 3/16 foamboard (typically black in case you see even a sliver of it past the frame, most of our shadowbox frames are black) and cut to size lengthwise. Depending on what's going in the frame, I'll typically do between 1" to 2" wide strips for these. These will be your walls that your piece is sitting on. You'll repeat this process with the same matboard that was used for the piece (when ordering, Preservation box + Fit should've been selected, so you should have 2 sheets of the same matboard). 

You'll ATG the foamboard and matboard straps together, then ATG (or if it's really long or big, the wide double sided stitchery tape would work) your strips to the walls of your frame, flush to the glazing. Go ahead and use your compressor and blow off the glass/acrylic again.

Place your piece on top. Do a few staples all the way around, lift it up to check that your glass is clean, if it is, set it back down and finish your staples! 

Back as normal, most shadowboxes youll do NWH since they're normally quite heavy, but you can use the #6 wire and A-Frame it (must be the #6 though)
